title: Recorder fault probe 2: a plain AppKit app, own-window ScreenCaptureKit with a window filter and a display filter
why: In cmux the window-filter stream gives frames only when a page child window changes (Cmd-T), not for terminal output or a split (probe round 1, cmux24 and cmux22). This plain app shows whether a window filter misses ordinary layer updates on these minis, and whether a display filter with the own window sees them.
